applicableAreas: cover sheet and site plan sheets
findings.comment: Plan notes reference 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance' instead of 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' per current ordinance.

applicableAreas: general notes sheet and site plan sheet
findings.comment: Site Plan Release Notes missing item 7 (numbering skips from 6 to 8), and orphaned/incomplete structural items in numbered lists.

applicableAreas: general notes, site plan, and fire protection plan sheets
findings.comment: Multiple spelling and grammatical errors: 'a trees Critical Root Zone' (should be 'tree's'), extra period in 'Subchapter E 2.5.', period instead of comma after 'driveway construction', 'This project includes 1 private hydrants' (subject-verb disagreement), and garbled text 'Not empty reasons'.

applicableAreas: general notes and fire protection plan sheets
findings.comment: Contradictory and duplicate notes: Electric Transmission Notes duplicated as both numbered and unnumbered items; Item 15 duplicates Item 2; Fire Zone Notes #4 duplicates general Notes #2; inconsistent fire suppression system reference ('NFPAR 13' vs 'NFPA 13D').
Corrupted or garbled text appears in Electric Transmission Notes: 'Not empty reasons, aerial equipment, dumpsters...' which appears to be a transcription error and is illegible/nonsensical.

applicableAreas: cover sheet, general notes sheet, and site plan sheet
findings.comment: Bracketed editorial/instructional text '(or identify the service provider if other than the City of Austin)' remains in multiple Site Plan Release Notes. This template guidance must be removed or replaced with actual project-specific information.

codeCitations: DSD Application Instructions; Standard Specifications Manual
findings.comment: Inapplicable boilerplate template text remains in Fire Zone Notes #1: 'Restricted Zone signage to be placed on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls...' This is marine/marina template language not applicable to a residential townhomes project and must be removed.

applicableAreas: cover sheet, general notes sheet, erosion control notes sheet, and site plan sheet
findings.comment: Multiple placeholder fields not replaced with actual values: IPM Plan document number blank (Sheet 1); 'TBD' for persons responsible for erosion/sedimentation control and tree protection maintenance (Sheets 3 and 6); 'X' symbols used as placeholders for parking data fields (ADA Spaces Required, ADA Spaces Provided, Compact Spaces Provided) (Sheet 9).

Title block date inconsistency: DCM Waiver approval date (01/21/2026) appears on cover sheet dated 01/21/2026, but site plan submittal date is 05/20/2025. The waiver date is chronologically after the submittal date, suggesting either the waiver date is incorrect or the approval post-dates the submission by approximately 8 months.
